mostWorthwhile.text: Forming the moon was most worthwhile: the debris gathered around the same world followed through its earlier impacts.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two premature attempts to use the orbiting rubble were repetitive, although their automatic results kept the sequence moving.

surprise.text: The world needed a separate grazing impact to create its debris cloud before the existing rubble could help form a moon.

arbitrary.text: Using metal-rich fragments before the moon-forming impact was not obvious beforehand, though the result explained how they contributed to the core.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: following the same material through impacts and different outcomes made the science and story engaging.
